title: First Hello

questions.prompt: Which of these is a host?
choices: A laptop
An Ethernet cable
A link light
The internet
questions.explanation: A host is any device that sends or receives data. A cable is a link, a link light is an indicator, and the internet is many networks joined together.

questions.prompt: What is the main job of a router?
choices: To connect different networks and pass traffic between them
To supply power to the devices plugged into it
To store the websites that people visit
To make an Ethernet cable faster
questions.explanation: A router joins networks, such as a home network and the internet, and forwards traffic between them.

questions.prompt: A laptop and a router are both powered on, but the link light on the router port the laptop is cabled to is dark. What should you check first?
choices: Reseat the cable at both ends, then try another cable or port
Call the internet provider to report an outage
Reinstall the laptop's operating system
Clear the web browser's history
questions.explanation: A dark link light points to a physical problem on that cable or its ports. An internet outage would not turn off the light between the laptop and the router.

questions.prompt: The link light on a port is green. What does that tell you?
choices: The physical connection between the two ends of that cable is up
The internet connection is working
The website you want is online
The Wi-Fi password is correct
questions.explanation: A link light only reports the physical link on that one cable. Data can still fail further along, so a green light rules out the cable but nothing beyond it.

questions.prompt: Maya runs ping -c 3 1.1.1.1 and sees "3 packets transmitted, 3 received, 0% packet loss". What does this show?
choices: Her test messages reached 1.1.1.1 and replies came back
Her cable is plugged into the wrong port
Her router is switched off
Three of her websites are down
questions.explanation: Ping sends test messages and waits for replies. Three sent and three received means the path works in both directions.

notes: Every correct answer is listed first here; shuffle the choices when loading them into the quiz tool.
